title: Ollama throw "Object of type Message is not JSON serializable" error
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
When testing the code in https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/stable/user-guide/agentchat-user-guide/tutorial/models.html#ollama-experimental with logging enabled. 
It show error: **TypeError: Object of type Message is not JSON serializable**

**To Reproduce**
Ollama is installed.
```python
from autogen_core.models import UserMessage
from autogen_ext.models.ollama import OllamaChatCompletionClient
import asyncio
import logging

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
    datefmt='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

async def main():
    ollama_model_client = OllamaChatCompletionClient(model="llama3.2")
    response = await ollama_model_client.create([UserMessage(content="What is the capital of France?", source="user")])
    logger.info(f"Sending message: {response}")

asyncio.run(main())
```

The output is as below:

          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen_core/logging.py", line 64, in __str__
    return json.dumps(self.kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".pyenv/versions/3.12.8/lib/python3.12/json/__init__.py", line 231, in dumps
    return _default_encoder.encode(obj)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".pyenv/versions/3.12.8/lib/python3.12/json/encoder.py", line 200, in encode
    chunks = self.iterencode(o, _one_shot=True)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File ".pyenv/versions/3.12.8/lib/python3.12/json/encoder.py", line 258, in iterencode

           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

    raise TypeError(f'Object of type {o.__class__.__name__} '

**Expected behavior**
Do not show any error in log.

linked_prs.title: Fix logging error with ollama client

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves a failure in handling LLM-related operations, specifically a serialization issue with the `Message` object when interacting with the Ollama LLM provider. This aligns with the "Incorrect model output handlers" sub-category under LLM operation issues.
